parts.note: severity per crash from what it destroyed: the test is whether the parts follow from the severity

cost.note: Estimate: each crash's cost weighted by how likely each part is damaged, the figure the seal reports. Booked: every part the garage replaced at its price-book mid, the entries in the books. The weekend total is not an independent test (two part prices were raised to land it near the AMuS figure), and the two press sources differ by 61%. The split between crashes is the real test.
